name: Connected agent (A2A)
summary: Caller agent that delegates to a remote agent via RemoteA2A connection.
description: Provisions a Foundry Prompt Agent with a BYOM-routed model, attaches an AgentCard, enables both `a2a` and `responses` protocols on `agent_endpoint`, and calls `/agents/{name}/endpoint/protocols/a2a` directly with `DefaultAzureCredential`. The reply text is generated by the BYOM model, proving the prefix survives the A2A hop.
notes: Verified end-to-end. Recipe: (1) `PATCH /agents/{name}` with `agent_card`, (2) `PATCH /agents/{name}` with `agent_endpoint.protocols = ['a2a', 'responses']` — both together, an a2a-only endpoint rejects calls with `EndpointProtocolNotEnabled`, (3) A2A JSON-RPC `message/send` + poll `tasks/get`, all bearer-token auth with `https://ai.azure.com/.default` scope (`cognitiveservices` scope 401s server-side). Neither PATCH is exposed on the SDK — raw REST helper lives in `_shared.attach_agent_card`. The A2A-as-tool caller-side flow (agent-to-agent from a Foundry caller) still needs a registered A2A connection with credentials and is tracked separately on `tool-a2a`.
